decisions.reason: The candidate's existing same-message MODIFY already captures the separate Wix accounts and payment setups used to preserve location-specific payouts.
The candidate's same-message INTRODUCE already records that each operational location uses a separate Wix website and account.
The candidate's existing same-message MODIFY already records selection on the master site and routing to the chosen location's separate Wix website.

The booking platform remains Wix; the separate-site and routing details are already represented by the standalone-site and location-routing Requirements and do not alter this candidate's platform requirement.
Separate location accounts, reporting, and payment setups do not change the established Smash Room brand name.
The concrete separation of current location operations is compatible with, but does not change, the existing requirement to support future location integration.
The master site continues to bring the brand, locations, and information together; separate operational accounts do not modify that role.
The location account and reporting arrangement does not alter the visual-design references, layout style, or navigation style.
